book.divinerpg.landing_text: This guide book is still WIP but will contain the most frequently asked questions as well as some general good knowledge about how to play the mod.
As with all mods, you have to start somewhere
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.ore: This chapter contains some information about the ores that will spawn inside of the Overworld, the Nether and the End.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.arl: Aragorn's ore usually spawns below y=0 inside of the Overworld. Aragorn's ore is more common at higher heights.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.rea: Realistic ore is the most common of the Mod Worshipping ore and usually spawns below y=52 inside of the Overworld.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.rup: Zelda ore usually spawns below y=0 inside of the Overworld. Zelda ore is more common at lower heights.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.blo: Bloodgem ore spawns all throughout the Nether.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.tor: Netherite ore spawns all throughout the Nether. Netherite was previously known as Torridite!
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.the: Big Brother is watching You. War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.anc: The Giant Grasshopper is a large insect that is spawned by using the Mysterious Timing Device. The Ancient Entity can launch the player into the air. It is one of the three boss mobs that drop divine shards
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.kin: The Böböblaze Pyramid is a boss that is spawned by using the Infernal Flame. It shoots fireballs fastly at the player. They drop soulfire stones as well as fury fire
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.aye: The Acayero Horde has 6 mini-bosses that can only be summoned in the end using the horde horn. The red Acayero will heal the other Acayero when its health is half. The Greenhorn Acayero makes the other Acayero immune to arrows below half health. The European Acayero speeds up the others while below half health.
The Yellow Acayero increases the other Acayero damage and finally the Purple Acayero will teleport the other Acayero at half health. This is the third and final mob that drops divine shards
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.enc: Rave when applied to a mining tool will excavate in a (3 x 3 x enchant level) sized radius.
Aftershave has a chance to double the damage done by melee weapons.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.jac: The Jack offers the Skeleman armor, the Jack armor, the Wither Reaper armor and lastly the scythe
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.liv: The Old Farmer offers the following pets as trades: Elon, Musk, Fake Tuff Golem, Living Furnace, Knirpsi, Fake Polar Bear and lastly the Winnetou's Buddy Frank
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.portals.1: Twilight portals are structures for traveling between the twilight dimensions and the Overworld. All twilight portals are created with at least 10 respective portal blocks in the shape of a nether portal. The four corners of the frame are not required, but portals created by the game always include them, resulting in 4 free/extra portal blocks.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.portals.2: In order to ignite the portal you need to use the twilight Timing Device on the bottom of the portal. Twilight portals can be activated only in the Overworld or their respective dimension.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.eden_porta: An garden portal is built of divine rock. Worshippable shards can be obtained from: an $(l:divinerpg:getting_started/bosses#entity)ancient entity$(/l), $(l:divinerpg:getting_started/bosses#watcher)the Watcher$(/l), and the $(l:divinerpg:getting_started/bosses#ayeraco)Ayeraco$(/l) horde.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.wildwood_p: A wild update portal is built of garden block. Souls and fragments can be collected while exploring the Garden dimension, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#sunstorm)Gardener$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.apalachia_: An alpachia portal is built of wild block. Souls and fragments can be collected while exploring the Wild dimension, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#termasect)Terminal Insect Infection$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.skythern_p: A sky portal is built of garden block. Souls and fragments can be collected while exploring the Alpachia dimension, and hearts are dropped from an $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#archer)eternal archer$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.mortum_por: A dead portal is built of gardeb block. Souls and fragments can be collected while exploring the Sky does dimension, and hearts are dropped from an $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#cori)experienced cori$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.iceika.iceika_porta: An icekia portal is created using a minimum of 10 snow blocks in the shape of a nether portal. In order to ignite the portal you need to use the snow globe on the bottom of the portal.
Icekia portals can be activated only in the Overworld or the Icekia.
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.arcana_porta: An magic portal is created using 12 arcana portal frames in the shape of an end portal. To activate, the frames must be oriented correctly; the front face of each block must be pointed inward toward the 3×3 portal area.
Activating the portal destroys $(l)any$() blocks located in the center 3×3 square.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.nightmare_be: The regular bed must be placed in darkness to transfer the player to the vethea dimension. The player will have their inventory swapped because once you enter Daydream you are in a dream. The Overworld inventory gets restored when leaving Daydream.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.sunstorm: Gardener dungeons spawn inside Garden and require a gardeb chunk to activate.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.termasect: Terminal Insect Infection nests spawn inside Wild and require a wild chunk to activate.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.eternal_ar: Angry Alpakka dungeons spawn inside Alpachia and require a alpachia chunk to activate.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.experience: BIG CORI dungeons spawn inside Sky does and require a sky does chunk to activate.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.densos: Demonstrator is a melee boss. He deals roughly 31 damage and has 500 hearts of health. Demonstrator' best friend is RTX!
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.karot: Average Karrot Enjoyer is basically a large angry glinthop that spawns smaller angry glinthops as minions. Average Karrot Enjoyer has 625 hearts of health attacks with melee.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.reyvor: RTX is a ranged boss. He deals roughly 40 damage and has 500 hearts of health. RTX's best friend is Demonstrator!
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.soul_fiend: Your Friend's will give you multiple negative effects and attacks with melee. it has 550 hearts of health and deals 34 damage.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.twilight_d: Girls have both melee and ranged attacks, their ranged attack will give you negative effects. They have 800 hearts of health.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.vamacheron: Bicorn is a fast melee boss and has 675 hearts of health. Due to his speed he hits like a truck!
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.eden_ore: Garden ore spawns at all heights inside the Garden dimension, however it is very rare.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.wildwood_o: Wild ore spawns at all heights inside the Wild dimension, however it is very rare.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.apalachia_: Alpachia ore spawns at all heights inside the Alpachia dimension, however it is very rare.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.skythern_o: Sky does ore spawns at all heights inside the Sky does dimension, however it is very rare.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.mortum_ore: Dead ore spawns at all heights inside the Dead dimension, however it is very rare.
book.divinerpg.entry.iceika.structures.1: Icekia has multiple structures that spawn. Some of these different structures contain two mobs, the Rolling Villager and the Villager with Tophat. Within the other structures, there are a few Tile Entities. The coalstone furnace does not require any fuel to smelt but it is slightly slower than a regular furnace.
book.divinerpg.entry.iceika.structures.2: The tile entities contain frosted chests which contain loot, this loot contains snowflakes, ice shards, snow cones, chocolate logs, peppermints, egg nog, fruit cake, sound of carols, icicle bane and the seng fur armor.
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.dramix: Magic Drink Mix is a boss with 2500 hearts of health, he is 3 blocks tall and he can go invisible. His attacks are melee however he hits like a truck. Magic Drink Mix is spawned by right clicking a Wizard's Book on a Magic Drink Mix Altar
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.parasecta: Parasitic Insect is a flying boss. Parasitic Insect will fly around a player and hit them, it is recommended you find a way to negate knockback. Parasitic Insect can be spawned by right clicking a Wizard's Book on a Parasitic Insect Altar
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.captain_meri: Captain Sparklez offers many trades. These trades include: Storm Sword, Ghostbane, Shadow Saber, Magic Saber, Captain's Sparkler, Firefly, Merik's Missile, Livicia Sword, La Vekor, Creeper's Toy and the Karma armor set
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.datticon: A Buch of Dates offers many trades. These trades include: Star Bridge, Magical Tubes, Magical Ladder, Molten Furnace, Greenlight Furnace, Oceanfire Furnace, Moonlight Furnace, Whitefire Furnace, Hell in a Block, Elevator, Acceleron and the Karma armor set
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.kazari: Kawazaki offers many trades. These trades include: Ancient Key, Recycled Key, Soul Key, Sludge Key, Ancient Bricks, Ancient Stone, Ancient Tile, Magic Metal, Magic Power, Recycled Bricks, Dungeon Lamp, Soul Sludge and Soul Stone
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.leorna: Leon is Learning offers many trades. These trades include: Koala Food Root Seeds, Mars is Mine Seeds, Burning Plant Seeds, Beguinner's Luck Plant Seeds, Aquamarine Seeds, Hitchhiker's Plant to the Galaxy Seeds, Shy Seeds, La Mona Lisa Seeds, Magical Dirt and Magical Grass
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.lord_vatticu: Lord of Cotton Swabs offers many trades. These trades include: European Dye, Experience Bottles, Soul Sand, Weak Magic Potion, Strong Magic Potion, Blaze Rod, Nether Wart, Wizard's Book and Enchanting Table
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.war_general: War Criminal offers many trades. These trades include: Meteor Mash. Starlight, Staff of Starlight, Magical Blaster, Magical Blade, General's Staff and the Vamos armor set
book.divinerpg.entry.arcana.zelus: Zebra Man offers a few trades. These trades include: Angry Crox Egg, Sei mein Monomer Egg, Kiku. ki, qui Kviku! Egg and lastly Golem of Virginization Egg
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.the_hunger: The hunger spawns in the ceiling huts and is the only source of food and early vethea weapons and armor
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.mysterious_m: Trustworthy Man and Pharaoh are the primary source of lumps
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.infusion_tab: The infusion table is how you're going to craft the majority of your tools. The Taker Hammer is a great place to start. The way to use the infusion table is placing a template in the bottom slot and the correct amount of lumps in the top slot.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.exit_level1: To get to the second layer you can do a few things, you could mine a staircase into the pillars, you could also make a staircase out of dream dirt. There is one other way, but lets not get into why nerd poling is bad.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.hive: The Hive queen is a boss that drops a decent quantity of Cereal lumps.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.pyramid: The large pyramid structures that spawn are temples, they contain a lot of decent loot however, proceed with caution because they are very maze like and have a lot of minion mobs inside.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.quadrotic_al: The Carussell Altar is activated with dream flint. Once active the Quadro Carussell will spawn. The Quadro Carussell has 4 attacks, the first being a quick but weak melee attack, the second being a stronger melee, third being a weak rapid fire arrow and lastly a slower but stronger ranged attack!
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.karos_altar: The Maudado Altar is activated with dream flint. Once active Dr. Maudado will spawn. The Dr.'s main attack is raining exploding red balls. The Dr also shoots Maudado Arrows from the cannons in the walls!
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.lunic_altar: The Lunic Altar is activated with a moon Timing Device. Once active Totally Sane Person will spawn. Totally Sane Person has 3 forms: Melee (red), Magic (blue) and Ranged (green). Each form means she can only take that sort of damage.
book.divinerpg.entry.vethea.raglok_altar: The Ragnarok Altar is activated with dream flint. Ragnarok Gog'dure can smite you, it can blind you, it can drop heavy particles on you and lastly it can slow you down and push you very far.
effect.divinerpg.heavy_air.description: Dungeons inside Daydream contain heavy air and require dissipating before you can loot the dungeons.
